chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from Durust ibn Abi Mansur has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah have mercy on him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washsha', from Durust ibn Abi Mansur Al-Wasiti.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father, referring to the author's father
key_terms.السَّعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Sad ibn Abdullah, a prominent narrator
key_terms.الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الْوَشَّاءِ: Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washsha', a narrator known as the 'Weaver' or 'Seller'
key_terms.دُرُسْتِ بْنِ أَبِي مَنْصُورٍ: Durust ibn Abi Mansur, a key narrator

ai.seo_question: Who is the narrator chain for Durust ibn Abi Mansur in this hadith collection?
ai.summary: This passage serves as a foundational *takhrij* (verification) note by Shaykh al-Saduq, explicitly linking the narrations of Durust ibn Abi Mansur to the Prophet through a continuous chain (*isnad*) starting with his father, Imam Muhammad ibn al-Husayn. By detailing the intermediate scholars such as Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa and Ali al-Washsha, al-Saduq reinforces the reliability of the Kufi transmission tradition and provides readers with the necessary scholarly context to trust the authenticity of these reports in *Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih*.
